evidence.observation: Enter is pressed on the title card and the session begins; the player appears at the spawn point.
evidence.riff: The menu is the starter's, unchanged - the only thing added to the input map is F.

evidence.observation: A and D walk; Space clears the first step. Movement and jump values are the starter's.
evidence.riff: Fixed-height jump, no double jump. Everything built later had to fit inside this envelope rather than widen it.

evidence.observation: The Runner's trail extends as horizontal speed builds and shortens when it drops.
evidence.riff: The character reports its own state. Standing still visibly puts it out, which the level then punishes.

evidence.observation: Walking over a dropped recorder raises a one-line fragment and the LOG counter advances.
evidence.riff: Story arrives as a reward for moving over it rather than as signage the player runs past.

evidence.observation: Ledges shake on contact and fall away a moment later; the player keeps moving across them.
evidence.riff: Contact-triggered, not timed - an untouched ledge stays solid, which a check asserts.

evidence.observation: The section opens into a high gantry and a lower deck; the route takes the high road.
evidence.riff: Both branches are survivable. The decision is a route preference, not a trap.

evidence.observation: Touching the feather grants the ability; the HUD switches to FEATHER / READY and a card names the power.
evidence.riff: One pickup, permanent ability. Before it, F does nothing at all.

evidence.observation: F inverts gravity; the Runner falls upward onto the ceiling and runs along its underside.
evidence.riff: A sign flip, not a tuning change - the measured inverted jump is 56.05 px against a normal 56.00 px rise.

evidence.observation: The world switches from pale daylight to near black on the same frame gravity inverts.
evidence.riff: Light is the comfortable lie; dark is what is actually there. Colour cannot disagree with orientation because gravity chooses it.

evidence.observation: The player walks out over a gap with no floor drawn beneath them and is carried across.
evidence.riff: The collider is ordinary. Only the drawing withholds it - nothing was added to the physics.

evidence.observation: Inverted, the hidden floor renders as a cyan lattice where the player has been standing.
evidence.riff: Inverted sight shows substance. That is the whole rule, stated once in a single frame.

evidence.observation: A gap identical to the one that caught the player is genuinely empty; walking in is fatal.
evidence.riff: The lesson is not that hidden floors exist. It is to check instead of assume.

evidence.observation: A slab drawn exactly like solid ground is not solid.
evidence.riff: Drawn and solid are independent properties. Upright vision shows the lie; inverting removes it.

evidence.observation: A bulkhead marked DOOR LOCKED has no collider and the player walks straight through it.
evidence.riff: A dead end that is the intended path. By now the player has been taught that signs are claims.

evidence.observation: Spikes drawn in full detail do not harm the player passing over them.
evidence.riff: The opposite lie to the hidden floor: lethal-looking and completely safe.

evidence.observation: A clear stretch of floor under a sign reading SAFE contains spikes that are never drawn.
evidence.riff: The worst lie in the chapter, and the reason the mirror ledge above it exists.

evidence.observation: A platform absent while upright is solid while inverted, and carries the player over the hidden spikes.
evidence.riff: Real in one world only. It completes the set: there-but-unseen, seen-but-not-there, real-only-inverted.

evidence.observation: The finish sits above the floor inside the tower shaft and is entered by falling upward.
evidence.riff: A check asserts a normal jump cannot reach it, so the mechanic is load-bearing rather than decorative.

evidence.observation: The death card names the cause, then the player is returned to the spawn point with the death counted.
evidence.riff: The starter's retry, untouched. Charges, gravity, collapsed ledges and collected logs all reset with the attempt.

evidence.observation: Enter on the completion card restarts the chapter at the spawn point with the death count reset to zero.
evidence.riff: Replay is the starter's behaviour and still works after everything added on top of it.

evidence.observation: Escape freezes the world and the timer; Enter resumes from the same position.
evidence.riff: Verified by position rather than by eye - the run asserts the player has not moved while paused.

evidence.observation: R returns the player to the spawn point without incrementing the death counter.
evidence.riff: A restart is not a death. The counter separates the two, which matters for the route evidence.
